summary: This is an 8-K filed by Porsche Auto Funding LLC as depositor for Porsche Innovative Lease Owner Trust 2026-1, reporting the takedown of $911,000,000 aggregate principal amount of asset-backed notes (Classes A-1 through A-4) under an existing shelf registration. The filing is a routine undertaking to file legality and tax opinions (from Mayer Brown LLP and Richards, Layton & Finger, P.A.) at the time of issuance. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The transaction is a standard ABS securitization of auto lease pools, not a corporate event that would qualify as a special situation, and thus no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
